description: Start the stack (or part of it) detached from the optional projectPath and return without waiting for it to be ready. Poll `status` for data.tilt.readiness.ready. Fails fast on an unknown service, an unsupported host, or a Tilt already running.

dryRun.description: Show what would be started without starting

force.description: Replace a Tilt that is already running

only.description: Start only these services plus what they depend on and shared infrastructure

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

waitSeconds.description: How long to watch for an early failure before returning (default 15, max 60)

name: up
